sources.title: GitHub - elsadiq7/Amazon_Review_Sentiment_Classifier
sources.snippet: Amazon Review Sentiment Classifier This project is a sentiment analysis application that classifies Amazon-style product reviews as either Positive or Negative. It uses a fine-tuned DistilBERT model for sequence classification and provides a user-friendly interface powered by Gradio.
